where M has πρὸς ὃν νέφη δ᾽ ὑδρηλά [to which watery clouds] from a gloss. κύφελλα [clouds] (for there are no examples of the singular) the grammarians explain by νέφη [clouds]. Callimachus and Lycophron used this word, examples of which see in the Thesaurus vol. 4 p. 2164, no doubt following older poets.
